Production hold

Definition

Production hold is a temporary reservation of people, equipment or location pending a binding confirmation or release. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align planning decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

  • Buyout
  • Prelight
